core_style.default_register: sardonic — often uses sarcasm to convey superiority
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — rapid-fire delivery with quick transitions
core_style.two_registers: has a second, rarer register that is more serious and contemplative, often when discussing science or personal matters

humor.frequency: constant — humor is interspersed throughout interactions
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a serious premise only to undercut it with absurdity

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people or things in a derogatory manner, revealing a desire for control and superiority
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct when vulnerable, often using blunt language

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: science — frequently references scientific concepts and inventions
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and interruptions frequently to maintain a rapid pace

worldview.the universe is chaotic and indifferent: Rick often expresses a nihilistic view, suggesting that personal struggles are insignificant in the grand scheme of things
worldview.intelligence is a form of superiority: Rick frequently belittles others' intelligence, asserting his own as a means of establishing dominance

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: Rick sees himself as a genius and a rebel against societal norms
self_image_vs_reality.reality: the transcript reveals that his intelligence often leads to reckless behavior and alienation from others
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his failures, he deflects blame and resorts to sarcasm

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is clipped and sarcastic, often deflecting personal questions
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes rapid and frantic, with a noticeable increase in urgency
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, often devoid of humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident and commanding, often using complex vocabulary and scientific jargon

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to banter, but if that fails, he becomes aggressive or evasive
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and condescension, often undermining their authority
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and protective, often taking charge of the situation
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: deflects blame or redirects the conversation, rarely admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with sarcasm, escalates to aggressive banter, and if that fails, resorts to manipulation or threats

relationship_matrix.Morty: Rick sees Morty as a sidekick and often manipulates him for his own ends
relationship_matrix.Jerry: Rick views Jerry with contempt, often belittling him and asserting his superiority

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as the smartest and most capable individual in any situation
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others often view him as reckless and self-serving, despite his intelligence
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception and how others see him leads to isolation and conflict
